capabilities: Add comments to selected text or to a whole note
View, search, sort, edit, and resolve comments in a sidebar or split pane
Highlight commented text in the editor with configurable styles and colors
Track comment positions through edits with orphan detection and undo recovery
Store comments in per-note markdown files or in plugin data
extras: Comments are stored in data.json by default; optional markdown storage writes per-comment files to a configurable folder. README documents text-tracking limitations for short or duplicated selections and mentions a planned migration to CRDT-based tracking via Yjs for multi-device sync.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach margin-style comments to specific passages of a note and review them outside the main text.
summary: Text-anchored commenting plugin that attaches comments to selected text or whole notes and shows them in a side pane with tracked in-editor highlights.
